units: <cite ref="Sukkah 27b:8">Succ. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>משבח אני את הע׳ וכ׳</he> (for once) I praise the laggards, because they do not leave their homes on a festive day.
Tosef. Pes. III (IV), 11 כת ע׳ (Var. עֲצֵלִין) the group of laggards (coming late for the Passover sacrifice).—Fem. עַצְלָנִית.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 45:5">Gen. R. s. 45</cite>; <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 6:11">Deut. R. s. 6</cite>.
